CHATTANOOGA, TENNESSEE 37401
September 6, 1972
Mr. G. Douglas Hofe, Jr., Director Bureau of Outdoor Recreation U. S. Department of the Interior Washington, D. C. 20240
Dear Mr. Hofe:
DRAFT ENVIRONMENTAL STATEMENT - DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR - USE OF OFF-ROAD VEHICLES ON THE PUBLIC LANDS
In accordance with your request of June 1, 1972, we have reviewed the draft environmental statement for the proposed implementation of Executive Order 11644 which pertains to the use of off-road vehicles on the public lands. We believe that the statement covers the considerations which are pertinent to the proposed policies and guidelines.
Thank you for the opportunity to review this draft statement.
Sincerely yours,
F. E. Gartrell, Dr. P. H.
Director of Environmental Research and Development
